proposal.description: The restart on agreement is applied only when flag_in is low, so an aborted release attempt (flag_in dips low while flag_out is high, then returns high) leaves its partial count in the disagreement counter
proposal.reason: With flag_out high, a low glitch on flag_in shorter than RELEASE_CLKS leaves the counter at the glitch length. A later low pulse then releases flag_out early, once the two together reach RELEASE_CLKS, instead of after RELEASE_CLKS continuous low clocks. Aborted asserts are still restarted correctly.

proposal.description: The flip compare adds a one-clock lookahead (counter+1) to make up for flag_out being registered, so flag_out flips one clock before the counter reaches its target and restarts
proposal.reason: Every transition with a target of 2 or more clocks shows up at flag_out one clock early. Because the counter only restarts on the next edge, an immediate reversal after an assert starts with the counter at ASSERT_CLKS-1, which is already past the release target, so flag_out flips straight back after one clock instead of waiting RELEASE_CLKS.
